text: APPROVE: the extracted `MatchesRequestedVersion` helper drops the nested `if` and `&&` from `Parse`, which lowers its complexity by several points (17 to roughly 13), and it keeps the same ordinal `num` comparison and the same `continue` on a mismatch. One assumption: I couldn't see the lines after the `if`, so this relies on them being the plain `return ReadVersion(crateName, entry)` that the old early return duplicated; the signature and nullability are fine for a warnings-as-errors build.
